title: Count Them Twice

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: A day weighed by lost children — a school roof in Pakistan, a shooting in Oregon — with a tanker burning near Hormuz, orange haze over Indonesia and thin Arctic ice. Small lights: Somalia sets elections, the Elwha tribe nears its land, Sentinel-3C opens its eyes.

lines: The roof gave way on the morning lesson,
thirty-two coats still on the hooks.
In Oregon a bell rang out for no one,
three small desks with open books.
a tanker burned where the oil goes through,
Kyiv ran short of things to stop the sky with,
and the northern ice grew thin and blue.
Hold the small hands, count them twice,
the Elwha's running wide and free —
a people one signature from home,
a new eye sending back the sea.
